text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But you know, I think I've done pretty well up till now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I ran in the Satsuki Sho. Healed my nail. Did well in a G2 and other races. Like, low-key, I crushed it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: When people think of me, I hope they think of everything I did last year.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now, though… things aren't looking too hot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So no one needs to see me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text: My mom's here! Let's all go to the beach today!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! ☆ Party! Party! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text: …Jordan? You good? Wait, you have today off too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, yeah! I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm supposed to rest my legs, so… pretty sure I don't need to check with my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru E
text_block_list.text: Whatcha doin' on your phone over there? Messaging your crush?

text_block_list.name: Gyaru D
text_block_list.text: …No! Ugh, c'mon, let's go already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: New Year's is over and school has been back in session for a few days now. But still no word from Tosen Jordan.
choice_data_list: (She's leaving me on read…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've reached out on LANE, and even visited her classroom, but she seems to be avoiding me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Buzz, buzz…)
choice_data_list: Could it be…

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hello. Is this Tosen Jordan's trainer? Do you have time to talk?
choice_data_list: Oh, uh… how can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Well, one of my students just reached out to me…

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: I lost at tryouts agaaain! I haaate schoool!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text: Holy, the water's colder than my teacher's stare after I failed that test for the fifth time. ☆

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (The beach, the ocean… This is nice.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (Wonder if my nails will peel off if I put my feet in. I didn't bring any oil or anything…)

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text: …Jordan? Are you gonna get in?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah… Sure.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (Well, you know what? Who cares what happens to my nails?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I think I'm done worrying about it.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru D
text_block_list.text: …Jordan?
choice_data_list: Wait!
Wait!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trainer?! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Gyaru D
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Jordan! I've just been really worried about you recently, and…

text_block_list.name: Gyaru D
text_block_list.text: Teach, I really need your help! Do you have Jordan's trainer's contact info?!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru D
text_block_list.text: She seems really down. We try to cheer her up, but nothing works. We're heading to the beach now, and…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But… why? Why did you have to get a teacher involved?
choice_data_list: That's how worried she is about you.
That's how worried she is about you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, right! We just hang out together because we have the same dumb people vibes…
choice_data_list: Do you really think that's all?
Do you really think that's all?

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! What's going on?! Why is your trainer here?! And what's with the angry vibe?!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text: H-hold on a second! Jordan worked so hard last year, didn't she?! She should be able to have fun for today at least!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Jordan is like, our star! We need her to recharge so she can shine for us again! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you're such an inspiration for gals like us! You're like our star!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sounds like they really look up to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sounds like they really look up to you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But I… I'm not someone worth looking up to…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: If you want inspiration for girls like you guys, what about City? Or Helios, or Palmer? They're all way better than me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Plus, I'm legit dumb! Like, it's over for me! No way I can compete in senior year!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm just going to keep losing and losing and losing… Honestly, I shouldn't even be trying in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All it's gonna amount to is me running like crap and embarrassing myself…

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text: But… we're dumb too.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text: We look up to you so much, Jordan. From day one, you've let all of us dream bigger.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter how many times you lose, I just know you're always gonna slay.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: You really are a dummy!
You really are a dummy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?
choice_data_list: A big dummy! The biggest, even!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She plunged head first into the Triple Crown tour with only the vague goal of "making it big" to guide her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tried to shrug off injury with the pure desire to run in the Satsuki Sho, despite her entire career being on the line.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yo. Five nail tips done. Pretty good, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Okay, fifteen seconds, then! Grab your stopwatch—let's do it! Ready…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tackles training head-on with simple earnestness, even if she doesn't understand what we're trying to accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She works stupid hard, throwing herself into one foolish challenge after another.
choice_data_list: That's what makes you strong.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What are you… I…
choice_data_list: That's why you never gave up the fight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter what she's up against, she keeps fighting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Tosen Jordan were smarter, she would have set a practical goal and avoided the Satsuki Sho if her nails got worse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe she would have lost her will to run when she saw the lineup for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She would have understood what common sense deemed impossible for her, understood that giving up is always an option when faced with a wall.
choice_data_list: But you're a dummy, so you always chose to fight.
But you're a dummy, so you always chose to fight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter what others said, she faced even the most imposing walls with the unbridled optimism that they can be scaled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And, to be perfectly honest…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, we've made it this far somehow. All we can do is try our best, right?
choice_data_list: You're a badass when you fight.
You're a badass when you fight.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Quit joking around.
choice_data_list: I'm not. I honestly think you're cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her friends nod in agreement.
choice_data_list: So embrace your stupidity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next time common sense tries to get in our way, we just have to dumb down and take it on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all, common sense has never stopped her yet.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… You…
choice_data_list: What could be cooler than being the greatest dummy there is?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Are you stupid?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You know… You're the real dummy! Dumb, dumb, dumb dummy dumb!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Who's ever heard of being the greatest dummy, anyway? That's…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's something only a dummy like me could pull off!
choice_data_list: Now you're talking!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Shut up… dummy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tears Tosen Jordan has been holding in finally come pouring out.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Soy sauce noodles, broth, toppings! Put 'em together, and…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Close with capers!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So that's what you want me to aim for? You're kidding, right?
choice_data_list: Well, if you want to be the greatest, she's one of the walls in your way.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhh… yeah, no, I think that's pushing it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Lack of common sense aside, Gold Ship's prowess is undeniable, and she's announced her bid for the Senior Spring Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Just thinking about this is making me even dumber… So we really have to do this, huh? The… Osaka Hai, was it?
choice_data_list: That's right. The Osaka Hai comes first.
That's right. The Osaka Hai comes first.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …And close with capers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Jordan! Welcome back! Are you training right now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Palmer?! Um…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Did you decide on your goal? I'll join you if you're gonna run.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Do you mind if I ask you later?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cause my new goal is to be the greatest!
